products.name: HOA Architectural Request Desk
products.product: A focused HOA architectural request tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small homeowners-association management companies and self-managed community boards
products.problem: Applications, drawings, neighbor notices, deposits, committee questions, decision dates, conditions, and completion checks move through email and meetings.
products.valueProposition: Turns HOA architectural request tracking into a visible operating queue so every architectural request has a complete packet, traceable review, communicated decision, and condition closeout.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets HOA architectural request tracking software, HOA architectural request tracking tracker, HOA architectural request tracking template, and HOA architectural request tracking checklist searches.
